tk_product_influencers.message: View TikTok Influencers Related to the Product

tk_tiktok_influencers_tips.message: The following listed influencers have promoted similar products, and you can conduct further research according to different purposes.</br>Cross-border sellers: Based on the data, conduct further research on the style of the influencers' homepages to determine whether the influencers are suitable for promoting your own products.</br>Promotion content creators: You can directly refer to the relevant influencers with good data to learn how to create content.</br></br>When used in conjunction with the Influencer Wizard plugin, you can further analyze the influencer portraits, styles, data, scripts, highlights, and even imitate the scripts, etc.

tk_product_cnt_tips.message: Total number of TikTok shop products promoted by the influencer.

tk_sales_volume_tips.message: Total units sold through the influencer's TikTok videos, reflecting their overall sales-driving ability.

tk_follower_count_tips.message: The total number of the influencer's fans</br>can evaluate the influence of the influencer's account.

tk_average_views_tips.message: 达The total playback volume of the influencer's videos divided by the total number of videos</br>can, when combined with the number of fans, evaluate the influence of the influencer's creative content.

tk_engagement_rate_tips.message: Also known as the interaction rate, it is calculated as (likes + comments + favorites + shares) /views,</br>which can evaluate the attractiveness of the influencer's video content
